notes.title: Cygnus Pizza Race 0.9.0.13
notes.content:
Finals time!
Time for the Final Race of the tournament of Champions, so here's the first sighting of track 20!
The next patch will include the new champion ship will be unlockable for everyone who has beaten track 20.
Good luck racers!

notes.title: Cygnus Pizza Race 0.9.0.9a
notes.content:
August Track first release.
Go check out Track 17, and see if you can beat the current record of 1.18!
Welcome to the August Track! Several small fixes were applied to make it easier to navigate.
Linux AMD graphics remains a work in progress.

notes.title: June Final Patch, Prep for July Tourney
notes.content:
Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7b
Minor fixes to make sure Linux and Windows are on a fully synchronized codebase, and prep for the July tourney.

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/161b9118fabc97407c33c522747ff14217cf35f8.png

Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7a
Welcome to the June track! There's more than one route to victory on this month's track.

This is also our first Linux release! Please report any bugs promptly on the forum.
Please consider this Linux release to be a bit of a "beta" stage, while we continue to work out known issues with AMD cards.
We are working to resolve these, but we have spent quite a lot of time trying to track them down, and we felt it best to get this game in your hands sooner rather than later.

Enjoy the track!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/ce9ee518f691b08601ade99c4abbed89a7d900f0.png

notes.title: Patches and prep for June tourney
notes.content:
It's time for the June tourney!
This build includes patches, prep, and updates to get everything ready for the competition.
Minor fixes added, framerate adjusted for 144hz screens and hopefully smoother streaming.

notes.title: CPR May Tourney Signups
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/5b65ea756c3b1783183bbff2093480f1c18c6d84.png

The new May track is coming May 30th, and here's your shot to race for prizes and access to the track before anyone else! 
Join the May Tourney by contacting us on Twitter or the Forum and then compete based on track times on a voter selection of tracks. 
Finalists will be racing head to head on the brand new track before it's available to anyone else - and the winner gets some fun prizes!

Signups close May 26th so hurry now to get in before the cutoff!

Check out the forum for specific rules and prizes. 
https://forum.longplay.games/t/may-tournament-for-the-cygnus-pizza-race/120?u=miguelb

We'll see you at the finish line!

[previewyoutube=VIs-vpuFDQ8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Final Updates before the May tournament!

notes.title: Cygnus Pizza Race Season 2: Out Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/8764e755a47b8aec7d5ea2195b999453692419d8.png

Today is the debut of Season 2, come join in the fun!

Rev up those pepperoni powered pizza pods racers, we have a whole season of great tracks coming, 10 in all. The first track of Season 2 awaits - and then a new track will coming for free every month, along with a tournament. There are 9 more tracks coming, and 9 more exclusive Pizza Pilot hats to be won, but first you'll have to able to beat your fellow racers. 

Time to get started!
